variants.name: Indexed binary heap with decrease-key
variants.idiom_name: hand-rolled heap with a key-to-position map
variants.implementation_notes: The variant when the algorithm genuinely needs decrease-key or removal-by-key. The position map is updated on every swap, and the invariants (heap property plus map consistency) are what the tests must check - a map that misses one swap path fails intermittently.
variants.code_sketch:
// every swap must update the position map
fn swap(&mut self, i: usize, j: usize) { self.heap.swap(i, j); let (a, b) = (self.heap[i].key, self.heap[j].key); self.pos.insert(a, i); self.pos.insert(b, j); }
pitfalls: A missed position-map update on any code path is the bug.
More code to test than the standard heap.
